black_level.note: Known black of this body type; the free photon-transfer intercept reads 2054, black minus the read-noise term.

clip.note: Raw value the histogram piles up at; WHTLVLN reads 11765.

gain.note: EOS 100D class value. This camera: own shared fit 1.95-2.08 per channel over 3 sequence(s), no clean sequence in the sample. Sky photon transfer is a lower bound and its method floor is ~10%; replace with a flat-field photon transfer (panoptes/panoptes-pipeline#99).

note: No read noise: the photon-transfer intercept (2054 ADU) lies above the 2048 black, so the fit implies a negative read-noise term and measures nothing. Left unknown rather than recorded as zero; a flat-field photon transfer (panoptes/panoptes-pipeline#99) or a bias frame would measure it.
